_meta.purpose: Hard production and metadata limits per platform. The validator reads these - do not hardcode limits anywhere else.
_meta.recheck_cadence: quarterly - platforms change limits without notice

file.dpi_note: DPI metadata is ignored. Redbubble's printers use actual pixel dimensions. Give them as many pixels as the source supports.
file.scaling_note: One uploaded image is auto-fitted to every product. Undersized uploads are centred with white borders, not stretched.
file.templates: Use Redbubble's per-product templates to check the printable area before publishing.

title.rule: Front-load the strongest keyword. Tight, readable, not stuffed.

tags.rule: Multi-word phrases only. 60% specific long-tail / 40% broader category. Do not duplicate title token sets.

description.rule: Natural language. Use cases and gift contexts. MUST NOT repeat the title verbatim.

ranking_signals: description that does not repeat the title
ban_triggers: same design uploaded across many colourways as separate listings
redbubble.audience_note: Young, browse-and-discover, aesthetic-led. Illustration outperforms typography in wall art. Stickers are the volume product.

file.colour_profile: embed sRGB; generate from PSD/TIFF and export at highest quality

rejection_reasons: filters used to mask poor quality
text or important content within 200px of any edge
a frame or border drawn inside the composition
essential elements cut off on upload
copyright, moral rights, or publicity rights violations
displate.resubmission: Rejected or removed artwork is blocked from resubmission as a duplicate. Get it right the first time.

title.rule: Evocative and specific. Name the feeling, not just the subject. No published character limit.

collection.rule: Group families of work. Collections are a browse surface.

displate.market_note: Top sellers are overwhelmingly LICENSED IP (Star Wars, Marvel, anime, major game franchises). Unlicensed sellers should target the open categories: Cars, Nature & Landscapes, Space, Floral, Japanese & Asian, Inspirational, Travel, Cute, Animals.

file.warning: A white background prints as a visible white rectangle on the garment. Transparency is mandatory.

title.rule: Hard limit enforced since 2026-07-27. Over-limit titles get flagged and progressively replaced with an AI-generated rewrite; brand-registered sellers get a 14-day review window.

brand.rule: Treat as a keyword slot, not a vanity name.

bullets.rule: Only the first ~1,000 bytes across all bullets is indexed. ~67% of shoppers are on mobile where each bullet truncates at 70-80 chars, so the first 80 characters of bullets 1 and 2 carry almost all the weight. Structure: Result -> Feature -> Proof. Capitalise the first 2-4 words as a visual anchor.

backend_search_terms.rule: Never include brand or competitor names. This is a named trademark violation actively reported by rights-holders.

demand_thresholds.saturation_signal: If more than 5 of the top 10 listings are established brands with 500+ reviews, or heavily optimised Merch sellers, treat the niche as saturated.

file.delivery_note: Ship every ratio family as a separate file. Do not crop one master - regenerate per ratio so the composition survives.

title.rule: First ~40 characters carry the ranking and display weight. Must contain a COLOUR word for decor, and a RELATIONSHIP word for gifts.

tags.rule: Use all 13. Fill the 20 characters - multi-word phrases only. Spaces count. Do NOT repeat words already in the title.

description.rule: Natural language supporting the title, not repeating it.

attributes.rule: Fill every structured attribute - colour, orientation, style, room.

nursery_wall_art.note: highest average order value - multi-print set purchases

etsy.set_behaviour: Multi-print sets carry the highest AOV. Design in families of three sharing one palette.

file.note: Large master file; style-led decor audience similar to Etsy's.

metadata.rule: Style and colour led. Same decor search grammar as Etsy.
Owned by the same group as Redbubble; apply Redbubble's phrase-tag discipline.

2:3.note: Dominant US poster ratio - movie and concert posters

3:4.note: 18x24 is the commercial framing standard, heavily favoured in modern interiors

1:1.414.note: ISO A-series - required for non-US buyers; A2 and A1 most common

1:1.4.note: Close to but NOT identical with A-series - generate separately
